profiles.name: hi_two_col_math_q
profiles.notes: Layout-family gate for the two-column math question page. Only p34/p35 are human-verified, but any page matching these measurable facts belongs to the same family and passes the gate (content errors are caught by the invariants). The gutter_ink check is the discriminator: a single-column or table page has ink crossing the band between the two column ranges. min_anchors_total is page-level, not per-column, because a question may span both columns (e.g. p30).
